requirements.quote: Use office-electrical/project.json as the explicitly synthetic electrical scenario. Calculate the circuit design current and conditional ampacity/voltage-drop checks, and create an editable device overlay and calculation report.

requirements.quote: Convert that overlay to native DWG in AutoCAD 2027, independently reopen it and reconcile the three device circles and labels. Generate a padded schematic PDF; this example does not require a fixed engineering scale.
requirements.acceptance: Convert that overlay to native DWG in AutoCAD 2027, independently reopen it and reconcile the three device circles and labels. Generate a padded schematic PDF; this example does not require a fixed engineering scale.

requirements.quote: Use two-zone-energy/project.json for the synthetic thermal scenario. Keep thermal loads separate from lighting electricity; do not report annual energy.
requirements.acceptance: Use two-zone-energy/project.json for the synthetic thermal scenario. Keep thermal loads separate from lighting electricity; do not report annual energy.
